title: Iman with Conviction: Aqeedah in the Face of the World
description: A pathway that moves your young man (16-18) from inherited iman to certainty with conviction, steadfast before the world: grounding personal iman, confronting atheism and contemporary doubts, aqeedah as a compass for decisions, and life for a greater purpose.
